name: vaft-documentation

scripts.docs:serve: npm run data && bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload
scripts.test:docs: npm run data && bundle exec jekyll build && ruby scripts/validate_docs.rb
scripts.test:docs:develop: npm run data && bundle exec jekyll build --config _config.yml,_config.develop.yml --baseurl /vaft/develop --destination _site-develop && VAFT_DOCS_BASEURL=/vaft/develop VAFT_DOCS_SITE=_site-develop ruby scripts/validate_docs.rb

description: Source of the VAFT documentation site; built and published by docs/build.py.
